unilateral_termination.unfair_example: The Company may terminate this agreement at any time without notice or cause.
unilateral_termination.fair_version: Either party may terminate this agreement with 14 days' written notice. Upon termination, all outstanding payments for completed work shall be settled within 30 days.

liability_waiver.unfair_example: The Company shall not be liable for any damages, direct or indirect, arising from this agreement.
liability_waiver.fair_version: Each party's total liability under this agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable under this agreement. Neither party excludes liability for fraud, gross negligence, or death/personal injury.

indemnity_shift.unfair_example: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless the Company from any and all claims, damages, and expenses.
indemnity_shift.fair_version: Each party shall indemnify the other against claims arising from its own negligence or breach of this agreement. Indemnification obligations are mutual and proportional.

auto_renewal_trap.unfair_example: This agreement automatically renews for successive 12-month periods unless cancelled 90 days before renewal.
auto_renewal_trap.fair_version: This agreement renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party provides 30 days' written notice before the renewal date. A reminder notification will be sent 45 days before auto-renewal.

non_compete_overreach.unfair_example: For 2 years after termination, you shall not work in any capacity for any competitor worldwide.
non_compete_overreach.fair_version: For 6 months after termination, you agree not to directly solicit the Company's current clients with whom you had material contact during the last 6 months of engagement. Geographic scope is limited to the region where you performed services.

ip_assignment_overreach.unfair_example: All work product, ideas, and inventions conceived during the term belong exclusively to the Company.
ip_assignment_overreach.fair_version: Work product created specifically for and during the scope of this engagement belongs to the Company. Pre-existing IP and work created outside the scope of this engagement remain the creator's property.

arbitration_no_sue.unfair_example: All disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration administered by the Company's chosen arbitrator. You waive all rights to trial by jury or class action.
arbitration_no_sue.fair_version: Disputes shall first be addressed through good-faith negotiation for 30 days. If unresolved, disputes may be submitted to mediation or arbitration by a mutually agreed-upon neutral arbitrator.

payment_timing_risk.unfair_example: Payment will be made within 90 days of invoice approval. The Company reserves the right to delay payment for any reason.
payment_timing_risk.fair_version: Payment shall be made within 30 days of invoice submission. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month. Invoices are deemed approved if no dispute is raised within 14 days.

scope_creep.unfair_example: The Contractor shall perform such additional duties as may be assigned by the Company from time to time.
scope_creep.fair_version: The scope of work is defined in the attached Statement of Work. Any additional work beyond this scope requires a written change order signed by both parties, with adjusted compensation and timeline.

hidden_fee.unfair_example: Additional fees may apply. See terms at company.com/fees for the current fee schedule, which may be updated at any time.
hidden_fee.fair_version: All applicable fees are listed in Schedule A of this agreement. Any fee changes require 30 days' written notice and do not apply to the current billing period.
